_comment: One edition a month. Edit this file and summary.html, then run: python3 scripts/build-summary-pdf.py. The counts come from site/data/build.json; every quoted line is checked against site/report.html (or the KJV) before anything is written.
label: October 2026
this_month: The current-events log in Section XV carries dated updates through 23 October: each item read at a named outlet or in a primary document, each side's account printed where one was found, and every figure with whose count it is.
The test cases moved up to Section XXIII, so the report now closes on the counter-architecture, the signal, and three completed things.
The map draws every connection by its grade: dotted for analogy or correlation, dashed for contact, solid for a documented material relationship or stronger.
Section I gained two more accounts of the author's own testimony, given in his words and graded as testimony.
